head: 6ed9ace3a92f7435f84c2f75f0084a03070ae2e4
scope: Persisted application entities in the current local SQLite implementation; schema_migrations is excluded as infrastructure metadata.

entities.name: Business
entities.lifecycle: Created and updated through the business repository; removed only by full pilot reset in current code.

entities.name: Branch
entities.lifecycle: Created and updated through the branch repository; active is a boolean state; removed only by full pilot reset.
relationships: scopes products, sales, reports, and operational records

entities.name: Product
entities.lifecycle: Created and updated through the product repository; active is a boolean state; stock is a scalar quantity.

entities.name: Sale
entities.lifecycle: Normally created by checkout; no cancellation, refund, or normal deletion path was found.

entities.name: SaleItem
entities.lifecycle: Created with a Sale; immutable in normal checkout flows; cascades if the Sale is hard-deleted.

entities.name: InventoryMovement
entities.lifecycle: Appended by stock-changing workflows; no ordinary edit, reversal, or deletion path was found.
relationships: optionally references Branch, Product, and Sale

entities.name: RecipeBatch
entities.lifecycle: Legacy cooked-batch log created by recordCookedBatch; separate from ingredient-backed production.

entities.name: OwnerAlert
entities.lifecycle: Created or reused by alert workflows and later resolved; persisted default open conflicts with the TypeScript active value.

entities.name: ReceiptRecord
entities.lifecycle: Always created by successful live checkout and optionally created by the unused generic sale repository; read through sale/order workflows; no standalone domain type exists.

entities.name: OfflineQueueItem
entities.lifecycle: Checkout appends pending sale payloads; no active uploader or retry-state writer was found.
relationships: optionally scoped to Business and Branch

entities.name: AppSetting
entities.identifier: TEXT id generated by makeSettingId; key is separately unique
entities.lifecycle: Read and upserted by preference and context services; omitted keys represent no stored value.

entities.name: Ingredient
entities.lifecycle: Created and updated through grocery-pool paths; is_active supplies logical deactivation.

entities.name: IngredientLot
entities.lifecycle: Created by grocery purchase; remaining quantity changes by selected-lot operations; status can become depleted or archived.
relationships: referenced by usage and movement history

entities.name: IngredientMovement
entities.lifecycle: Active writers append purchase, adjustment, and recipe_usage rows; spoilage is allowed by the type vocabulary but no ingredient-lot spoilage writer was found.

entities.name: Recipe
entities.lifecycle: Created and edited through recipe services; is_active supplies logical archival.

entities.name: RecipeIngredientLine
entities.lifecycle: Created with a recipe and retained with cost/source snapshots; no line update or delete path was found beyond cascade and full reset.
relationships: optionally references Ingredient and selected IngredientLot

entities.name: ProductionBatch
entities.lifecycle: Created atomically with ingredient usages, stock deductions, output stock, and movement history.
relationships: optionally references Branch, Recipe, and output Product

entities.name: ProductionIngredientUsage
entities.lifecycle: Created with a ProductionBatch as a historical cost and quantity snapshot.

entities.name: SaleIngredientUsage
entities.lifecycle: Created during cook-upon-order checkout; may record estimated usage and shortfall.
relationships: belongs to Sale, SaleItem, and Business
optionally references Recipe, Ingredient, and IngredientLot

entities.name: ProductTransfer
entities.lifecycle: Created atomically with source and destination stock movements; no reversal record exists.
relationships: references source/destination Branch and Product where retained

entities.name: FixedCost
entities.lifecycle: Created and archived through fixed-cost services; no general update path was found, and archive status controls report inclusion.

entities.name: FixedCostPayment
entities.lifecycle: The active writer creates paid occurrences; skipped is a declared/persistable value but no skip writer was found. Occurrence uniqueness is checked in application code only.

entities.name: ProblemReport
entities.identifier: TEXT id generated with Expo Crypto.randomUUID and a problem_ prefix
entities.lifecycle: Created locally with diagnostic JSON and status open; no writer that transitions it to resolved was found.
relationships: optionally scoped to Business and Branch

materialNonEntityState: Owner PIN and biometric preference in SecureStore
In-memory kiosk cart, checkout token, shift totals, and last receipt
Theme preference mirrored in Zustand and app_settings
Derived analytics, profit summaries, and production plans
knownAbsentEntities: Durable owner, seller, user, account, or membership
Import, export, backup, or restore job
